procedures.title: Air conditioning: general description
notes: The section covers three systems: Four-Season (all vehicles, including Corvette), Comfortron (Chevrolet only) and the dealer-installed GM Chevrolet Air Conditioner (not Corvette).
Underhood parts (compressor, condenser, receiver-dehydrator) are similar in type, location and mounting across systems.
The compressor is a six-cylinder reciprocating unit, bracket-mounted on the engine and belt-driven from the crankshaft pulley.
The condenser sits in front of the engine radiator; the receiver-dehydrator is in the refrigerant line after the condenser.
All components are joined by flexible refrigerant lines.
